_meaning: Hand verdicts on probe-credited rows. Each verdict is my reading of the requirement next to the pointer the probe produced, recorded so the probe's precision is a measured quantity with a stated sample size rather than an assumption.
_method: python3 -B eng/spec-coverage/assess.py sample <n> --tier TEST-ASSERTED,CODE-PRESENT --seed <seed> [--app ...], then read the requirement text against the pointed file and its matched terms.
_scale: verdict true = the pointed first-party code genuinely addresses this requirement's subject; verdict false = the match is coincidental vocabulary, or the pointer is not implementation evidence.

_samples.note: the printed sample was truncated at 10 rows by the terminal capture; only those 10 were judged and only those are recorded
